svg.text: Checks that each Action Type + Equipment has its required File Types and Value Types
Layer 2: Provenance & Audit (Check Value Sources... & Tools > Audit Log...)
Verifies Reader/Derived numbers against stored files and logs every Create/Update/Delete
Layer 3: Electronic Signature (Right-click Item > Signature > Sign Item...)
Computes content hash, applies SIGNED badge, and permanently locks the item against edits
